Team.heading: Meet the Team
Team.text: Section with the growing dendrimer tree lalala

members.name: Meagan Davies
members.description: Passionate about interdisciplinary teamwork and research in biology, medicine, engineering, physics, and astronomy. Outside academics, I love coffee, tea, drawing, reading, and writing.

members.name: Sofea Zamzuri
members.description: Passionate about research in biology and making an impact in the field of science. Outside of academics, I love baking, reading, and watching hockey.

members.name: Allan Vu
members.description: I enjoy playing ping pong with my friends.

members.name: Sukhmanpreet Waraich
members.description: Passionate about exploring the opportunities at the intersection of biology and healthcare, and excited by the many ways science can come together across different fields to make a real difference in people’s lives. Outside of academics, I love exploring new cafés, hiking, and spending time with friends and family.

members.name: Nam Phuong Dinh
members.description: I like music, running, and hiking.

members.name: Neeor Alam
members.description: Retired thought leader and jack of all trades. I work on everything ranging from coding to biology research to creative work, and love learning things. Outside academics I play both deep story games and grinding games while trying to keep on top of all the side quests I try to approach.

members.name: Shahzaib Khan
members.description: Passionate about biomedical engineering, medicine, and improving healthcare through research and innovation. Outside of academics, I enjoy skiing, staying active, and exploring new places.

members.name: Anahat Sidhu
members.description: Inspired by the intersection of engineering and medicine, I enjoy learning, collaborating, and solving meaningful problems that can improve lives. Outside of academics, you’ll often find me crocheting, painting, or working on a creative DIY project.

members.name: Hannah Nguyen
members.description: Living proof that everything works out eventually.
